Eyenovia, Inc., a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company, engages in developing a pipeline of ophthalmology products in the United States.The firm is worth $55.97 million. It is developing MicroProst that has completed Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of chronic angle closure glaucoma; MicroStat that has completed Phase II clinical trials for the treatment of mydriasis; MicroTears for the treatment of dry eye; and MicroPine for the treatment of myopia.Currently it has negative earnings. The firm was formerly known as PGP Holdings V, Inc. and changed its name to Eyenovia, Inc. in May 2014.
